# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User requested a complete MonoGame migration strategy for their Discord RPG. I created: 1) MONOGAME_MIGRATION_STRATEGY.md (50+ page master reference), 2) Multiple quick-start guides, 3) Production-ready starter code (7 classes, 655 lines), 4) Implementation checklist, 5) Complete file structure guide. The strategy covers 8 phases over 4-6 weeks with reuse of existing game logic. User prefers practical, phased approaches.
